title: Implement automatic database seeding with default job roles on deployment

requirements.summary: Update JobRoleSelector to show loading state during job role initialization
acceptanceCriteria: Loading state displays while job roles query is in progress
User sees a spinner or skeleton loader during initialization
Error message 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' only appears for genuine errors, not during loading
Smooth transition from loading state to populated job role list

file_operations.description: Add loading state handling to display a spinner or skeleton loader while job roles are being fetched. Replace the immediate error message 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' with conditional logic that checks if the query is still loading. Only show the error message when the query has completed (isLoading is false) and the jobRoles array is genuinely empty. Import and use a loading component (e.g., Spinner from shadcn/ui or a skeleton loader) to provide visual feedback during the initial fetch or seeding process.

Review and ensure the useGetJobRoles hook properly exposes the isLoading state from React Query. Verify that the loading state correctly reflects both the actor initialization (actorFetching) and the actual query loading state, similar to the pattern used in useGetCallerUserProfile. This ensures JobRoleSelector can distinguish between loading and genuinely empty states.
